title: Electricity net imports (Ember via OWID)

indicator.name: Electricity net imports
indicator.description: Net electricity imports: Electricity imports minus exports, measured in terawatt-hours.

source.name: Our World in Data – Energy dataset (Ember electricity data)
source.license: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data; underlying Ember data CC BY 4.0)
source.citation: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026); Ember – Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026) – with major processing by Our World in Data. File owid_energy.csv downloaded from https://catalog.ourworldindata.org/energy/owid_energy/owid_energy.csv on 2026-10-12 19:10 UTC (server Last-Modified: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:42:02 GMT).

upstream.name: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026) and Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026)

notes: Imported from data/raw/owid/owid_energy.csv, column "electricity_net_imports_twh", years 1990 on (one row per country and year; the latest year with a value is shown, the full series is kept for charts and derived datasets).

Codebook (data/raw/owid/owid_energy.codebook.csv) title: "Net electricity imports"; unit: "terawatt-hours (TWh)"; sources: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026); Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026); Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy of the UK – UK's historical electricity data (2023).

Rows with a blank iso_code are matched by their "country" name: Kosovo -> XKX; regions, income groups and source-defined aggregates (e.g. "Europe (EI)", "G20 (Ember)", "World") and former states are skipped. A blank cell is kept as missing, never 0.

scoring.rationale: Absolute volume in TWh; the share of supply is used instead (import exposure).
